Class ThinkPaneManager

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.swing.ThinkPaneManager
public final class ThinkPaneManager extends Object
The ThinkPaneManager class is the gateway to a thinking pane. A caller asks with a context key and receives that context's pane. The same key returns the same instance for the session. One canvas has one pane, and every cell on that canvas receives it. One SSH pane has one pane. A different user has a different set of panes. The stream receives the returned reference and writes that instance. A reply ends on that pane and does not release it. Close hides the pane and does not release it. release(String) drops a pane only when that session ends.

    • sshKey

      public static String sshKey(String user, String surfaceId)
      The method returns the key for one SSH pane and one user. The surface id is the pane instance. A null user is stored as empty. A null surface id is stored as empty.
      Parameters:
      user - the sanitized user
      surfaceId - the SSH pane id
      Returns:
      the key

    • bind

      public ThinkStrip bind(String key, ThinkStrip strip)
      The method returns the pane already bound to key. The first call stores strip and returns it. A later call returns the stored instance. A null key returns strip without storing it.
      Parameters:
      key - the context key
      strip - the pane the surface built
      Returns:
      the pane for that key

    • acquire

      ThinkStrip acquire(String key, ThinkPaneManager.StripSource source)
      The method returns the canvas pane for key, creating it once. A key that already has a pane returns that pane. A null source on a missing key returns null.
      Parameters:
      key - the user and scope key
      source - the builder used the first time
      Returns:
      the pane

    • rememberCell

      void rememberCell(String user, String cellId, String key)
      The method records which pane a cell writes. Every cell on one canvas records that canvas key. A later pause finds the pane through this record.
      Parameters:
      user - the sanitized user
      cellId - the cell id
      key - the pane key

    • findCell

      ThinkStrip findCell(String user, String cellId)
      The method returns the pane that receives this cell's stream. A cell that has not acquired a pane returns null.
      Parameters:
      user - the sanitized user
      cellId - the cell id
      Returns:
      the pane, or null

    • release

      public void release(String key)
      The method drops the pane stored at key. The call is the end of that session. Close does not call this method. A reply does not call this method. A missing key returns without a change. Cells that recorded this key lose that record. The stream drops the block for that pane. The pane object is not folded and is not cleared.
      Parameters:
      key - the context key

    • releaseStrip

      public void releaseStrip(ThinkStrip strip)
      The method drops every key that holds strip. A null strip returns without a change. The call is the end of an SSH session. Close on the strip does not call this method. A canvas pane stays until that session ends.
      Parameters:
      strip - the pane that is leaving

    • forgetKey

      private void forgetKey(String key)
      The method removes cell records that point at key.
      Parameters:
      key - the pane key that is leaving

    • applyBodyFont

      void applyBodyFont(Font font)
      The method applies the body font to each canvas pane. An SSH pane keeps the font its terminal set.
      Parameters:
      font - the monospaced body font
